components.text: Mechanist measured shafts, Skyward altitude. I measured what bites. In the Founders' journal I am the Wildlander.$(br)$(br)⚠ Danger ratings are my scale, not HP from code. I will not invent another mob's health.
I leave the diary at the portal. If the hole closes while I am inside, the map ends. Do not sketch an «Ash Colossus» in the margin: that beast is not in the pack.
